title: Founder of a seed-stage agent startup

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for hopping on. What are you building?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Coding agents that keep an entire repository in context, so we're memory hungry by design.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How are you running that today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Rented GPUs from a neocloud, about thirty-two of them. Our margins are underwater because most of the spend is memory, not compute.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Is there a specific cost you're trying to hit?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We need gross margin above fifty percent before our Series A in about six months.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What have you tried so far?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Mostly software. We use vLLM's paged attention and some prompt caching. It helped, but not enough.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: If a hardware option made sense, what would hold you back?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Price, honestly. We can't sign anything that looks like a big annual contract right now.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who else would be involved in that decision?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Just me and my co-founder. We decide fast.
